cells.gaps: The only statement of absence is a third-party legal-status page (Levellers, reviewed 8 June 2026), not an Eritrean government source. Systems.csv holds only ministry-plan, thematic and sector-ict instruments (HSSDP III, IGIF action plan, ICT in Education policy, Communications Proclamation 1998), none a national digital strategy, so nothing stands in the way of stage 1 but nothing lifts it either.
cells.note: Instrument: none; the evidence is a dated statement that Eritrea has no national digital transformation strategy, with nothing adopted, launched or in preparation on record. Stage 1 is the floor and no strategy exists to place higher.
